items.title: Asymmetric Factorized Bilinear Operation for Vision Transformer
items.description: A higher-order visual representation method for Vision Transformers using asymmetric factorized bilinear operations and structured sparse channel mappings.
items.authors: **Authors:** **Junjie Wu**, [Qilong Wang](https://csqlwang.github.io/homepage/)†, Jiangtao Xie, Pengfei Zhu, Qinghua Hu

items.title: Distribution Alignment-based Language-Image Pre-Training for Domain-Specific Data
items.description: A domain-specific vision-language pre-training method that aligns image-text feature distributions and models second-order token statistics.
items.authors: **Authors:** **Junjie Wu***, Jiangtao Xie*, Zhaolin Zhang, [Qilong Wang](https://csqlwang.github.io/homepage/)†, Qinghua Hu, Peihua Li, Sen Xu

items.title: Effective Visual Token Aggregation for Improving ViT Classification
items.description: A visual token aggregation study for improving ViT classification through cross-covariance token pooling.
items.authors: **Authors:** Jiangtao Xie*, Zhaolin Zhang*, Ruiren Zeng*, **Junjie Wu**, [Qilong Wang](https://csqlwang.github.io/homepage/), Peihua Li†

items.title: GDT-VLM: Global Distribution Modeling for Visual Token Compression in Efficient MLLMs
items.description: A visual token compression method for efficient MLLMs that preserves global visual distribution information under severe token budgets.
items.authors: **Authors:** Jiangtao Xie*, **Junjie Wu***, Zhaolin Zhang, [Qilong Wang](https://csqlwang.github.io/homepage/), Peihua Li†

items.title: VIGIL: Causal Visual Evidence for Multimodal Question Answering
items.description: Defines operation-matched estimands for evidence removal, directed replacement, and context editing, then tests how activation-level localization transfers to parameter adaptation under shared behavioral endpoints.

items.title: LiveSearchVQA: Certifying Search Necessity for Web-Search Agents
items.description: An on-demand visual QA benchmark built from image-bearing news within 48 hours. Certificate-carrying items verify visual grounding, empirical search necessity, and evidence sufficiency, while a closed-book/with-search/oracle protocol attributes retrieval, distraction, and evidence-utilization failures.

items.degree: B.Eng. in Computer Science and Technology, GPA: 3.7/4.0, top 15%

items.title: Algorithm Researcher
items.description: Building multi-agent idea-to-script and evaluation-and-revision harnesses for overseas motion-comic short dramas, and developing data, evaluation, and generation pipelines for real-time emotional avatars.

items.company: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
items.title: Remote Research Assistant
items.description: Advised by Prof. Yongqi Zhang. Developed VIGIL to measure causal dependence on task-relevant visual evidence, and LiveSearchVQA to certify search necessity and evidence sufficiency for multimodal web-search agents; also built a closed-loop data-generation and full-parameter SFT pipeline for the Huawei TIR-Bench challenge.

items.title: Graduate Researcher, Machine Learning and Data Mining Laboratory
items.description: Advised by Prof. [Qilong Wang](https://csqlwang.github.io/homepage/). Developed higher-order visual representations for ViTs, domain-specific vision-language pre-training methods, and efficient visual token aggregation/compression methods for ViTs and MLLMs.

items.title: Remote Research Assistant
items.description: Collaborated with Prof. Pengtao Xie on foundation models for mRNA gene annotation and chest X-ray representation learning.

items.title: Algorithm Researcher
items.description: Built domain-specific multimodal models from scratch for the Yarnpal and Calo apps, covering dual-source data platform construction, three-stage training (domain knowledge injection, SFT, and GRPO), LLM-as-Judge evaluation frameworks, and single-GPU vLLM deployment; also developed multimodal RAG and agent pipelines and plant foundation models.
